cards.t: Franklin Templeton Adds HYPE to Crypto Index ETF
cards.b: Franklin Templeton has added Hyperliquid's native token to its crypto index ETF as US spot products reaching $266.5 million in AUM.

per.HYPE: Addition to Franklin Templeton's crypto index ETF.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: Exact weighting of HYPE within the index ETF.

cards.t: Ethereum Schedules Glamsterdam Upgrade Testnet Rollout
cards.b: Ethereum core developers have scheduled the Glamsterdam upgrade for the Hoodi testnet on December 15, moving ahead with contested gas changes after prior delays.

per.ETH: Hoodi testnet rollout of the Glamsterdam upgrade on December 15.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: Mainnet activation timeline following the testnet deployment.

cards.t: Injective Requests SEC Order-Book Rule Change for Tokenized Stocks
cards.b: Injective's developers have asked the SEC to allow order-book trading systems for tokenized stocks, arguing existing regulations unfairly favor single exchange formats.

per.INJ: Injective developer advocacy for SEC rule changes to permit order-book systems for tokenized stock trading.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: The SEC's timeline and decision on the request.

cards.t: Ripple Lending Plan Nears XRP Ledger Vault Launch
cards.b: Vaults designed to hold lenders' money on the XRP Ledger are on track to switch on December 9, bringing Ripple's lending plan closer to activation.

per.XRP: Vault activation on December 9 for the XRP Ledger lending plan.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: Final validator sign-off for the loan system's two-week clock.

cards.t: Bluefin Shuts Down Perps Platform to Focus on Spot and RWAs
cards.b: Bluefin will close its perpetuals platform on December 4 to pivot toward spot trading and tokenized real-world assets on Sui.

per.SUI: Perpetuals platform closure on Bluefin affecting ecosystem volume.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST
cards.missing: Specific launch dates for the new spot and RWA offerings.
